# Life Hacks Germany
> Verification-first practical guides for expats, students, workers, families, and locals living in Germany.
> Languages: English at /en and German at /de
> Contact: golifehacks@gmx.de
> Updated: 2026-07-06

## About
Life Hacks Germany publishes bilingual, official-source-backed guides for German bureaucracy, taxes, housing, mobility, and everyday life. The site is built for practical decisions: what changed, what to do next, which authority or official source to check, and what mistakes to avoid.

## High-priority current updates
- [Top Changes in Germany: July 2026](https://www.lifehacksgermany.com/en/blog/top-changes-germany-july-2026) — pension increase, care-sector minimum wages, minijob pension-insurance opt-back-in window, aviation tax, e-cigarette disposal, customs rules, Deutschlandticket, Rundfunkbeitrag, Kindergeld, Blue Card, and blocked-account baselines.
- [Top-Aenderungen in Deutschland: Juli 2026](https://www.lifehacksgermany.com/de/blog/top-changes-germany-july-2026) — German version of the July 2026 monthly update.
- [Top Changes in Germany: June 2026](https://www.lifehacksgermany.com/en/blog/top-changes-germany-june-2026) — E-car subsidy, GEAS asylum procedure changes, online cancellation buttons, energy sharing, food-label rules, public-viewing exceptions, Deutschlandticket, Rundfunkbeitrag, Kindergeld, Blue Card, and blocked-account baselines.
- [Top-Aenderungen in Deutschland: Juni 2026](https://www.lifehacksgermany.com/de/blog/top-changes-germany-june-2026) — German version of the June 2026 monthly update.
- [Top Changes in Germany: May 2026](https://www.lifehacksgermany.com/en/blog/top-changes-germany-may-2026) — fuel-tax relief, Bundesrat rejection of the employer relief premium proposal, hospital reform adjustment, hydrogen infrastructure acceleration, Deutschlandticket, Rundfunkbeitrag, and Kindergeld baselines.
- [Top-Aenderungen in Deutschland: Mai 2026](https://www.lifehacksgermany.com/de/blog/top-changes-germany-may-2026) — German version of the May 2026 monthly update.
- [Fuel Price Timing Hack](https://www.lifehacksgermany.com/en/guides/mobility/fuel-price-timing-hack) — updated for the April 2026 12:00 fuel-price rise rule and May fuel-tax relief context.
- [Spritpreis-Timing-Hack](https://www.lifehacksgermany.com/de/guides/mobility/fuel-price-timing-hack) — German version of the fuel timing guide.
- [Kindergeld and Elterngeld in Germany](https://www.lifehacksgermany.com/en/guides/everyday/family-benefits-kindergeld-elterngeld) — current Kindergeld amount is EUR 259/month per child from January 2026.
- [Kindergeld und Elterngeld in Deutschland](https://www.lifehacksgermany.com/de/guides/everyday/family-benefits-kindergeld-elterngeld) — German version of the family benefits guide.

## Source policy
Prefer official German government portals, official public institutions, official law texts, official provider pages, and official brand pages. Community sites can be used for discovery but are not final authority for legal, financial, immigration, health, or administrative facts.
